theme: Rent recovery is stabilizing but uneven
evidence: REIT street-rate declines narrowed to -3.9% YoY in Q4 2025; C&W reported asking rents up 1.7% YoY in Q2 2026.
dashboard_use: Executive overview, rent trend panel, MSA heatmap

evidence: TractIQ reported the first YoY REIT occupancy gain since Q4 2021, while C&W national median occupancy was flat at 90.0%.

theme: New supply is tapering, but Sun Belt pressure remains
evidence: Marcus & Millichap forecasts 53.0M square feet completed in 2026, 25% below the prior year; C&W reports Q1 2026 pipeline totals down 20% YoY, with South holding 35% of projects.
dashboard_use: Supply pipeline, region drilldown, pressure-risk flags

theme: Demand is still constrained by household mobility
evidence: Marcus & Millichap ties broader recovery to household mobility, subdued home sales and relocation activity; CubeSmart and EXR annual reports both describe seasonality and moving activity as occupancy drivers.
dashboard_use: Demand driver panel, external macro overlay

theme: Concessions remain an important pricing signal
evidence: C&W reports 73.1% of facilities offering concessions in Q2 2026 and a concession cost index of 159.1.

theme: Consolidation and third-party management are changing competition
evidence: Marcus & Millichap reports public companies at 37.3% of rentable square footage but 19.3% of facilities; large REITs expanded managed stores materially through June 2026.
dashboard_use: Competitive structure, operator mix, technology sophistication

theme: Transaction market improved from 2024 trough but remains below 2022 peak
evidence: Marcus & Millichap reports transactions and deal volume up nearly 20% and 50% YoY as of June 2026, but trading nearly 30% below the 2022 peak.
dashboard_use: Capital markets page, liquidity trend, cap-rate spread panel

theme: Technology and algorithmic pricing raise the competitive bar
evidence: Public Storage describes digital channels, eRental and pricing/search optimization; Marcus & Millichap notes REIT density can make submarket pricing more algorithmic.
